name: EPIC 212654643
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 9.8 solar radii and 1.13 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,489 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 1.13 solar masses and 9.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,821 K at its surface.
